name: Insight
description: Oracle-manipulation-aware pre-trade safety checks for DeFi AI agents. One trade in, a PASS/WARN/BLOCK verdict out — consensus price, max deviation %, manipulation-risk score, cross-provider agreement — backfillable to a verifiable EIP-712 attestation. Pay-per-call: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402 v2 or MPP (both challenges advertised on the same 402); settlement happens only after the check succeeds. Endpoint is MCP over Streamable HTTP.
